Connectivity you can trust

Many travel eSIMs resell someone else's service. GigSky is a mobile operator, which means we work directly with network partners. If something isn't working as expected, we're in a better position to help resolve the issue, not just forward your support request.

Land already connected

Install your eSIM before your trip. When you arrive, the GigSky eSIM automatically connects to the best available local network, with 5G, 4G, or LTE depending on the area. No QR codes to wait for and no manual APN settings after you land.

One eSIM for every trip

Install your GigSky eSIM once and keep using it across 200+ countries and 290+ cruise ships. Open the app, choose a new destination, and travel again without installing another eSIM.

Plans that match the way you travel

Whether you're checking maps a few times a day or working remotely with video meetings, choose from fixed or unlimited plans designed for light, medium, and heavy data users. Buy the data you need instead of paying for what you don't.

Know your data before you run out

The GigSky app helps you stay in control with built-in usage tracking and an alert when you've used 80% of your plan. No guessing, no surprise interruptions, and no wondering how much data you have left.

Everything you need, right away

Skip the airport Wi-Fi search. Open Google Maps, translate signs and menus, book a ride, message your hotel, or let your family know you've arrived safely, all as soon as your plane lands.

We are here for you!

Our 24/7 365-day customer service is available to help should you have any problems at any point your purchase, set-up or use of our service.
